Luis-apologies for the late note. Thank you for reporting the potential violating content from the FB page
of Fundación Contra el Terrorismo. As an update, we escalated this Page and the content provided and
while the Page as a whole doesn't violate our Standards, one of the posts that was flagged was confirmed
violating our Violence & Incitement policies and was removed.
Please let me know if you have any questions—happy to follow up.
